info.name: LaporKita API — QA Collection (National Competition)
info.description:
Koleksi Postman lengkap untuk pengujian REST API LaporKita (NestJS).
Base URL: http://localhost:3000/api/v1
Flow: 1) Register/Login → token tersimpan otomatis ke collection variable 'accessToken'. 2) Endpoint protected membaca token tersebut (Authorization: Bearer).
3) Ganti {id} di URL dengan ID nyata dari respons create.
Dokumentasi Swagger: http://localhost:3000/api/docs

request.description: Registrasi (Fase 3B OTP): response 202 Accepted, user dibuat is_active=false, OTP 4-digit dikirim via SMS (mock: lihat log server — [MOCK SMS] to +62xxx: your OTP is 1234). Email DAN nomor HP wajib keduanya (override Fase 3). OTP TIDAK pernah ada di response body.

Verifikasi OTP 4 digit (Fase 3B). OTP didapat dari LOG SERVER saat register (mock SMS: "[MOCK SMS] to +62xxx: your OTP is 1234"). OTP berlaku 5 menit (OTP_EXPIRY_MINUTES), max 5 percobaan (OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS). Sukses → is_active=true + access/refresh token. Error codes: OTP_INVALID, OTP_EXPIRED, OTP_ALREADY_USED, OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS.

Kirim ulang OTP (Fase 3B). Cooldown 45 detik (OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS): jika dipanggil terlalu cepat → 400 OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN + remainingSeconds di data (frontend render countdown 00:45). OTP lama di-invalidate, attempt_count di-reset.

exec: console.log('Resend OK — ambil OTP baru dari LOG SERVER, update {{otpCode}}.');
